thread:
Marta: Heads up — we're seeing OOMs on Citrine17b (int4) in canary at ~3-4 rps. Repro logs attached to the canary job.
Liam: noticed spikes. Memory jumps after KV populate then OOMs a few tokens into generation. Any quick mitigations?
Cheng: likely memory fragmentation from slot allocations with heavy prefetch. int4 tight packing makes fragmentation worse for many short interleaved requests.
Arjun: paste the canary config? batching, max_new_tokens, prefetch?
Marta: current canary config: {batch_size: 8, max_new_tokens: 512, prefetch_tokens: 256, kv_evict_threshold: 0.15, slot_compaction: false}
Liam: quick safe change: reduce batch_size to 4 and max_new_tokens to 256 for canary. Cuts peak working set and trims long tails.
Cheng: also enable slot_compaction=true and drop prefetch_tokens to 64. Prefetch=256 is too aggressive for our prompt mix.
Arjun: will lowering max_new_tokens affect our long-gen evals?
Marta: short-term canary uses prompts <200 tokens so no regression risk; we'll run long-gen evals separately on isolated nodes.
Liam: immediate patch diff for canary: batch_size: 8 -> 4; max_new_tokens: 512 -> 256; prefetch_tokens: 256 -> 64; slot_compaction: false -> true.
Cheng: add kv_trim_on_evict=true and kv_cache_reserve_pct=8%. On int4 the KV footprint is smaller but fragmentation creates holes; trimming reclaims space earlier.
Arjun: do any flags need a restart?
Marta: batch_size and max_new_tokens are dynamic; slot_compaction can be toggled live. kv_trim flags need a short model-worker restart.
Liam: rollout plan: flip dynamic flags in low-traffic window, monitor 30m. If stable, schedule rolling restarts tonight to apply kv_trim.
ci-bot: Deploy job queued: canary-config-update #3827 — cluster ml-canary-2. Owner: Marta.
Cheng: also enable allocator.smooth_buckets=true to reduce allocator churn for small-object patterns; that lowers fragmentation.
Marta: added allocator.smooth_buckets=true, kv_trim_on_evict=true, kv_cache_reserve_pct=8 to the patch.
Arjun: expected headroom after changes?
Liam: estimate ~30-40% reduction in peak working set on the int4 canary mix; should prevent OOMs.
ci-bot: canary-config-update #3827 STARTED by Marta.
Marta: smoke update: 45m with no OOMs, 99th latency stable, memory graph shows far fewer spikes. Small allocation churn persists but below threshold.
Cheng: next steps: run long-gen eval on isolated machines with max_new_tokens=256 to check for any quality regressions. If ok, make 4/256/64 + compaction the canary default for Citrine17b.
Arjun: please add a runbook entry in eng-ml with defaults, rationale (frag + prefetch), and rollback steps.
Liam: also add an alert for sustained kv_fragmentation_ratio > 0.2 so compaction is targeted before OOM.
Marta: created ticket MM-890 to add the alert and a short runbook PR. Will schedule restarts for kv_trim tonight. :thumbsup: 
ci-bot: canary-config-update #3827 SUCCEEDED.
